# Import data from Hovernet as SpatialFeatureExperiment

```{r echo=TRUE}
hov_file <- paste0(
"https://store.cancerdatasci.org/hovernet/TCGA_OV/json/",
"TCGA-VG-A8LO-01A-01-DX1.B39A4D64-82A1-4A04-8AB6-918F3058B83B.json.gz"
)

sfe <- HoverNet(hov_file, outClass = "SpatialFeatureExperiment") |>
import()


sfe
```


```{r}
coords <- spatialCoords(sfe)
x <- colData(sfe)$mean_intensity
y <- colData(sfe)$nnd  
```
